'''Hurd''' is a stableman in [[Toke Fearnim]]'s stable.

==Appearance==
Hurd is a squat man with almost no hair and no teeth.

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] goes to buy a horse for [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], Hurd and [[Adela]] show him the horses for sale.
